minecraft:written_book_content.title: Torn Field Notes
minecraft:written_book_content.author: unknown
pages: {"text":"Day 1 — I should not have come here. The fog rolled in before sunset, thick as wool. It moves wrong. It watches. I felt something brush my shoulder in the dark. There was no one there. I am writing this by torchlight because the dark feels heavier now."}

{"text":"Day 3 — The bells work. I rang the old iron bell at the chapel ruin and the fog thinned for a moment. Something screamed far off. I think it was angry. Three rings seemed to do it. Mark this: the bell is not just a tool. It is a weapon."}

{"text":"Day 7 — It has a shape now. I saw it between the trees — tall, wrong angles, watching. When I lit a lantern it stepped back. Light hurts it. Soul sand seems to calm the air around it. I collected some. The fog does not like the blue fire."}
{"text":"Final entry — If you read this, know: the fog is not weather. It is hungry. Do not let it find you in the dark. Stay in light. Ring the bell. And if you see the eyes — run. — C"}
